name: Admin Document List
description: View admin documents in the fixed business order Title, States, Created, Client, Project and Actions. The exclusive cycle appears before additive signals, every badge carries its open duration, Solucionar bug is visually prominent, overflow collapses to +N, and documents with no cycle show Por clasificar. Actions remain last. Landscape keeps Title, States, Created and Actions as columns while grouping Client/Project under Title; compact cards keep Title/States primary and order secondary metadata as Created, Client, Project. Filters and episode behavior are covered by admin-document-state-filters and admin-document-state-workflow.
